variants: AmK combust or with malefics instead of debilitated

meaning: The Sun and Rahu in the Karakamsa with Mars as the only aspecting planet is a specific fire combination.
inference: Setback: the native burns houses or helps arsonists.
variants: Venus aspect instead of Mars (see BK9_0031)

meaning: The Sun and Rahu in the Karakamsa aspected by Venus is the modified form of the fire combination.
inference: Setback: he does not burn houses himself but helps those who do.

meaning: The Sun and Rahu in the Karakamsa aspected only by Jupiter is a third version of the fire combination.
inference: Setback: fire-setting happens, but away from his own house.

meaning: Karakamsa falling in the Gulika period (Gulikakala) is the timing-of-birth condition.
inference: Setback: the native gives poison to others or dies by poisoning.

meaning: Karakamsa in Gulikakala together with a Moon aspect is the condition.
inference: Setback: becomes a thief or receiver of stolen goods.

meaning: The Moon aspecting the 12th from Lagna or Pada Lagna, with planets there, shows the type of expense.
inference: Setback: money lost through government or governing bodies.

meaning: Mercury in or aspecting the 12th from Lagna or Pada Lagna is the condition.
inference: Setback: losses from relatives and lawsuits.

meaning: Jupiter in or aspecting the 12th from Lagna or Pada Lagna is the condition.
inference: Setback: wealth drained by heavy taxation.

meaning: Mars and Saturn together in or aspecting the 12th from Lagna or Pada Lagna is the condition.
inference: Setback: financial losses through brothers.

meaning: Malefics in the 6th house from Pada Lagna are the condition.
inference: Setback: a tendency towards theft.

meaning: Arudha Lagna (AL) lying in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna is the placement.
inference: Setback: poor results in worldly image, status and fortune.

meaning: The arudha of any house falling in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Lagna is the placement.
inference: Setback: the matters of that house are harmed or poorly shown to the world.

meaning: Equal numbers of planets in 2nd and 12th, 5th and 9th, 12th and 6th, or 4th and 10th from Lagna form a bondage pattern.
inference: Setback: imprisonment or confinement.

meaning: Saturn and Rahu in the 11th or 3rd from the Upapada and its lord are tied to the brothers' fate.
inference: Setback: elder brother is lost by one, younger by the other, per the sutra's pairing.

meaning: Venus in the 3rd or 11th from the Upapada and its lord is the condition.
inference: Setback: loss of younger or elder brothers.
variants: Venus in 3rd from Upapada: younger brothers
Venus in 11th from Upapada: elder brothers

meaning: Saturn and Mars both aspecting the 3rd and 11th from the Upapada is the condition.
inference: Setback: brothers are destroyed.

meaning: Saturn aspecting the 3rd and 11th from the Upapada and its lord is the condition.
inference: Setback: loses all siblings and stays alone.

meaning: Weak Sun, Venus, Moon or Mars (the parent karakas) with malefic aspects points to harm to parents.
inference: Setback: death of father or mother indicated in the chart.

meaning: A strong parental karaka with benefic aspects makes the parent's death fall in a shoola dasa of its 1st, 5th or 9th sign.
inference: Timing claim: parent's loss in that shoola dasa period.

meaning: Shoola dasas of the signs 1st, 5th and 9th from Jupiter are linked to the wife's death.
inference: Timing claim: loss of wife in one of those shoola dasas.

meaning: Shoola dasas of the 1st, 5th and 9th from the karakas of children, uncles and other kin mark their deaths.
inference: Timing claim: relatives die in the shoola dasas of their own karakas' signs.

meaning: The lords of the parent houses, whether weak or strong, with a malefic aspect other than the Sun, give early parental loss.
inference: Setback: a parent dies before the native is twelve.

meaning: Saturn joined with Rahu or Ketu between the 1st and 12th houses (as the sutra defines) is the condition.
inference: Setback: the native will not perform his parents' funeral rites.

meaning: The stronger of the 9th from Lagna and the 9th from the 7th has its shoola dasas judged for the father.
inference: Timing claim: father dies in the most adverse shoola dasa of that 9th sign.

meaning: The 4th from the stronger of Lagna and the 7th has its shoola dasas judged for the mother.
inference: Timing claim: mother's death in a shoola dasa of that 4th sign.

meaning: The 3rd from the stronger of Lagna and the 7th has its shoola dasas judged for siblings.
inference: Timing claim: a brother or sister dies in a shoola dasa of that 3rd sign.

meaning: The 5th from the stronger of Lagna and the 7th has its shoola dasas judged for children.
inference: Timing claim: sons or sister's sons die in a shoola dasa of that 5th sign.

meaning: The 11th from the stronger of Lagna and the 7th has its shoola dasas judged for the elder brother.
inference: Timing claim: elder brother's death in a shoola dasa of that 11th sign.

meaning: Shoola dasas counted from the 9th house sign of Lagna or the 7th are applied to paternal uncles.
inference: Timing claim: paternal uncles die in the bad periods among those shoola dasas.

meaning: Malefics in the paka (dasa) sign and the bhoga sign counted from the dwara rasi are the condition during chara dasa.
inference: Setback: imprisonment, illness and mental and bodily trouble through that dasa.

meaning: Those same paka and bhoga malefics, if in their own sign or near Jupiter, do not produce the trouble.
inference: Cancellation: the affliction of the previous rule is removed when the malefics are in own sign or close to Jupiter.

meaning: A dasa sign that is malefic, aspected by malefics, holds debilitated planets, or has a debilitated lord is the poor-dasa test.
inference: Setback: good results fail in that dasa and bad ones come instead.

meaning: Mars in the 11th or 3rd from the Upapada or its lord, aspected by Saturn, is the condition.
inference: Setback: all brothers die except the native.

meaning: Equal numbers of planets in the 2nd and 9th houses form a pattern that Raman reads as adverse.
inference: Setback: great misfortunes in life.

meaning: Karakamsa falling in Saturn's shadvarga or joined by Saturn, Rahu or other malefics is the condition.
inference: Setback: doubt about legitimate birth.

meaning: In chara dasa, the Sun or Moon with Saturn in the 5th from the dasa sign, or Moon and Rahu in the 6th and 8th, is the condition.
inference: Setback: displeasure of government or authority during that dasa.
variants: Sun with Saturn in 5th from dasa sign
Moon with Saturn in 5th from dasa sign
Moon in 6th and Rahu in 8th from dasa sign

meaning: Malefics on both sides of the dasa sign, in its 8th, or in the sign itself describe a bad chara dasa.
inference: Setback: trouble, loss and an unfavourable period.
variants: Malefics in 2nd and 12th from dasa sign

meaning: Malefics in the 9th from the dasa sign during a chara dasa are the condition.
inference: Setback: danger to the father during that dasa.

meaning: Malefics in the 4th from the dasa sign during a chara dasa are the condition.
inference: Setback: the mother's health is endangered during that dasa.

meaning: The stronger of Sun and Venus is the Pitrumaraka; the father's death falls in the shoola dasa of its 8th lord's sign trine.
inference: Timing claim: father dies in the shoola dasa of the 1st, 5th or 9th from that sign.
variants: Venus weaker if Sun is stronger
Sun weaker if aspected by malefic

meaning: The stronger of the 9th from Lagna and the 9th from the 7th gives the niryana shoola dasa for the father.
inference: Timing claim: father dies in the niryana shoola dasa of that rasi or its 5th or 9th.

meaning: The stronger of Moon and Mars is the Matrumaraka, whose sign trines give the mother's dasa.
inference: Timing claim: mother dies in the dasa of the 1st, 5th or 9th from that rasi.

meaning: The stronger of the 4th from Lagna and the 4th from the 7th gives the niryana shoola dasa for the mother.
inference: Timing claim: mother dies in that sign's shoola dasa or its 5th or 9th.

meaning: Chara dasa of Jupiter's sign and its 5th and 9th, with a weak 7th house, is the condition for the wife.
inference: Timing claim: wife's death in those dasas when the 7th is weak.

meaning: The stronger of the 3rd from Lagna and the 3rd from the 7th gives the niryana shoola dasa for younger brothers.
inference: Timing claim: younger brothers die in its shoola dasas of 1st, 5th or 9th.

meaning: The stronger of the 11th from Lagna and the 11th from the 7th gives the shoola dasa for elder brothers.
inference: Timing claim: elder brothers die in shoola dasas of its 1st, 5th or 9th.

meaning: The stronger of the 5th from Lagna and the 5th from the 7th gives the shoola dasa for children, only if the chart promises children.
inference: Timing claim: children die in shoola dasas of its 1st, 5th or 9th.

meaning: Mars alone aspecting the Atmakaraka sign gives a fire-setting tendency.
inference: Setback: inclination to arson; Venus's aspect prevents real fire and Jupiter's lets fire come near without burning.
variants: Venus aspect also: no actual fire
Jupiter aspect also: fire near but no burn

meaning: The Moon aspecting the Atmakaraka sign is the theft condition.
inference: Setback: becomes a thief or has wealth stolen; Gulika in the sign adds poison dealing or death by poison.

meaning: Equal numbers of malefics in the 2nd and 8th from the Atmakaraka sign, Lagna or Pada form a Jaimini Kemadruma.
inference: Setback: poverty, worse with Moon's aspect, with results in the dasa of that sign.

meaning: Planets in or aspecting the 12th from Pada Lagna show a spendthrift nature, with the type of loss set by the planet.
inference: Setback: overspending; Sun/Rahu/Venus royal demands, Mercury fines, Jupiter taxes, Mars/Saturn brothers.

meaning: Malefics in the 2nd, 4th, 5th or 8th, or benefics in the 3rd and 6th, from the lagna lord or 7th lord is the condition.
inference: Setback: poverty; equal numbers on both sides give a happy life instead.

meaning: Equal numbers of planets on both sides of the ascendant or Atmakaraka sign (2 and 12, 5 and 9, 3 and 11, 4 and 10, 6 and 12) are the bondage pattern.
inference: Setback: misery or imprisonment; benefics give mild bondage, malefics chains and whipping.

meaning: Mercury in the Leo navamsa is the condition the teacher states.
inference: Setback: dependence on others and suffering from decisions on marriage, business or property taken on others' advice.

meaning: The Atmakaraka and Amatyakaraka in kendra or trikona from each other form a Jaimini rajayoga, stronger with the Putrakaraka also well placed.
inference: Status: strong rajayoga bringing rise in position.
variants: AK+AmK+PK all in auspicious houses: extraordinary

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 3rd house from lagna shapes the public image.
inference: Status: the world sees the native through communication, courage or enterprise.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 4th house from lagna shapes the public image.
inference: Status: image tied to property, home and education.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 5th house from lagna shapes the public image.
inference: Status: image of intellect, creativity and children.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 9th house from lagna, a trikona, shapes the image.
inference: Status: seen as wise, a teacher or tied to father; considered the strongest trikona position for AL.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 10th house from lagna shapes the image.
inference: Status: visible career and authority, with successes and failures made public.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in the 11th house from lagna shapes the image.
inference: Status: image of gains and wide social networks.

meaning: The Sun conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: authority and visibility but a rigid image.

meaning: The Moon conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: public appeal with a changeable reputation.

meaning: Mars conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: a bold but abrasive image.

meaning: Mercury conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: seen as clever, sometimes inconsistent.

meaning: Jupiter conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: wisdom and trust; the most favourable planet for the image.

meaning: Venus conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: charm, and shows more wealth than actually exists.

meaning: Saturn conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: a serious image; recognition is slow but lasting.

meaning: Rahu conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: inflated image and sudden fame, with a risk of exposure.

meaning: Ketu conjunct the Arudha Lagna colours the public image.
inference: Status: a detached image and indifference to status.

meaning: A strong Amatyakaraka, well conjoined and aspected, is the condition.
inference: Status: the native becomes a great minister, councillor or adviser.

meaning: Venus in the Karakamsa is the placement.
inference: Status: a high official or political figure, fond of women, with vitality into old age.

meaning: Benefics in the 2nd and 6th from Pada Lagna with no malefic aspect is the condition.
inference: Status: rule over many lands or a high governorship.

meaning: One planet aspecting Hora Lagna, Ghatika Lagna and Janma Lagna together is the condition.
inference: Status: becomes a ruler or equal to one.

meaning: One planet aspecting the Moon sign, navamsa lagna and drekkana lagna and the 7th from each is the condition.
inference: Status: a great ruler or maharaja.

meaning: One planet aspecting five of the six lagnas (lagna, ghatika, hora, moon, navamsa, drekkana) but not all gives a lesser form.
inference: Status: an ordinary rajayoga.

meaning: One planet aspecting navamsa lagna, hora lagna and ghatika lagna (or drekkana, hora and ghatika) is the condition.
inference: Status: rajayoga.

meaning: Venus, Mars and Ketu aspecting each other or standing in the 3rd from one another is the condition.
inference: Status: aristocratic family background or surroundings.

meaning: Benefics in the 2nd, 4th and 5th from the Atmakaraka is the condition.
inference: Status: becomes a king or holds equal rank.

meaning: Malefics in the 3rd and 6th from the Atmakaraka is the condition.
inference: Status: rajayoga, since malefics do well in those houses.

meaning: Benefics in the 2nd, 4th, 5th and 8th from the lord of Lagna or of the 7th is the condition.
inference: Status: rajayoga.

meaning: A mix of benefics and malefics in the same placements as the previous rajayoga dilutes it.
inference: Status: only an ordinary position, not a rajayoga.

meaning: The Lagna lord aspecting Lagna, and the lord of Karaka Lagna aspecting Karaka Lagna, is the condition.
inference: Status: strong rajayogas.

meaning: Venus and the Moon together in the 4th from the Atmakaraka is the condition.
inference: Status: royal comforts and honours.

meaning: A single planet aspecting the Janma, Hora and Ghatika lagnas together makes a strong royal combination.
inference: Tradition says the native rises to kingly or near-kingly power.
variants: Same test using Hora lagna and Ghatika lagna as separate reference points

meaning: Lagna and 7th house in rasi, navamsa and drekkana each touched by a planet by conjunction or aspect forms a rajayoga, stronger if one planet does it in all three.
inference: Tradition says high status comes, and more so when a single planet links all three charts.
variants: Same planet in all three charts gives the stronger form

meaning: Lagna lord and 5th lord joined, or placed in exaltation, debilitation or own navamsa, indicates a ruler.
inference: Tradition says the native becomes a great ruler or leader.
variants: Lagna lord and 5th lord in own navamsa
Lagna lord and 5th lord conjunct in one sign

meaning: Lagna lord linked with the 5th lord, or 7th lord linked with the 5th lord, gives a rajayoga that matures late.
inference: Tradition says status and power come, but only in the later part of life.

meaning: Venus in the Atmakaraka sign, Mars in the 2nd from it and Ketu in the 4th from it makes a kingly combination.
inference: Tradition says the native becomes a king or ruler.

meaning: When the lagna, 7th and 9th houses are all strong, political power is promised.
inference: Tradition says the native gains authority in public or political life.

meaning: An equal count of planets in the lagna and the 7th house gives a rajayoga that is enjoyed late in life.
inference: Tradition says status arrives in the later years.

meaning: An equal count of planets in the lagna and the 4th house brings fame and honour.
inference: Tradition says good name and public respect follow.

meaning: Jupiter and Moon placed in lagna and 11th, or lagna and 7th, with benefic aspect, make a ruler.
inference: Tradition says the native gains rulership or high command.

meaning: Mercury and Jupiter in lagna and 11th, or lagna and 7th, aspected by benefics, give an early-life rajayoga.
inference: Tradition says status and success arrive young.

meaning: The Moon in the 7th house, joined or aspected by benefics, makes the native a royal servant.
inference: Tradition says a ministerial or official post under authority.

meaning: If kendras and trikonas hold no benefic planets, the native serves a king.
inference: Tradition says the person stays in a subordinate service position.

meaning: Benefics, or planets in benefic vargas, in the Atmakaraka sign or its 10th give a moderate rajayoga.
inference: Tradition says a middling level of status and authority.

meaning: In the navamsa, the Moon placed 4th or 11th from Jupiter gives fame and power.
inference: Tradition says reputation and authority.

meaning: An exalted planet occupying or aspecting both the lagna and the Atmakaraka sign makes a ruler.
inference: Tradition says the native holds ruling power.

meaning: When the Atmakaraka's navamsa sign equals the lagna, the birth Moon sign or Jupiter's sign, a fairly high rajayoga forms.
inference: Tradition says a good level of status.

meaning: An equal number of benefics in the Arudha Lagna and in the navamsa sign of the 9th gives political power.
inference: Tradition says influence in public affairs.

meaning: Malefics in the 3rd and 6th from the Atmakaraka or from the Arudha Lagna make a ruler.
inference: Tradition says strength and command, as malefics in upachaya places help.

meaning: The Sun in the 6th from the sign of a running chara dasa gives favours from superiors and access to money.
inference: Tradition says that dasa period brings support from authority.

meaning: The Sun and/or Venus aspecting the Atmakaraka sign makes the native a state envoy.
inference: Tradition says a diplomatic or representative role for the government.

meaning: A benefic aspecting the 10th from the Atmakaraka sign gives a steady position and skill at settling disputes.
inference: Tradition says stable career and arbitration talent.

meaning: One planet aspecting Janma, Hora and Ghatika lagna, or aspecting 1st and 7th in rasi, navamsa and drekkana, makes a king.
inference: Tradition says very great fortune and royal status.
variants: Planet aspects the three special lagnas
Planet aspects 1st/7th in D1, D9 and D3

meaning: Benefics in the 2nd, 4th, 5th and 8th from the Atmakaraka, or malefics in the 3rd and 6th, give kingly rank, also counted from lagna or 7th lord.
inference: Tradition says high office.
variants: Malefics in 3rd and 6th from lagna lord

meaning: Full Moon and Venus in or with Karakamsa give wealth, comfort and earnings from teaching.
inference: Tradition says prosperity through education work.

meaning: The Sun in the 10th from Karakamsa, aspected only by Jupiter, gains through cattle trade.
inference: Tradition says income from livestock dealing.

meaning: The 4th lord from Karakamsa joined or aspected by Moon and Venus gives tall, multi-storey houses.
inference: Tradition says fine property.

meaning: An exalted planet in the 4th from Karakamsa gives many good houses.
inference: Tradition says several fine residences.

meaning: Rahu and Saturn in the 4th from Karakamsa give a house of rough stone.
inference: Tradition says a crude, heavy dwelling.

meaning: Mars and Ketu in the 4th from Karakamsa give a brick or earth house.
inference: Tradition says a house of baked or mud material.

meaning: Jupiter in the 4th from Karakamsa gives a wooden house.
inference: Tradition says a house built mostly of timber.

meaning: The Sun in the 4th from Karakamsa gives a thatched house.
inference: Tradition says a simple dwelling with a straw roof.

meaning: Rahu joining or aspecting the 9th from Karakamsa loses wealth through women.
inference: Tradition says money loss tied to female relationships.

meaning: Malefics in the 2nd and 8th from Lagna or Arudha Lagna, or 3rd from Karakamsa, give Kemadruma-like poverty.
inference: Tradition says a lack of money.

meaning: The same malefic pattern in 2nd/8th with the Moon aspecting deepens the poverty.
inference: Tradition says extreme want.

meaning: Planets in or aspecting the 11th from Arudha Lagna make the native wealthy.
inference: Tradition says the person never knows poverty.

meaning: Benefics joining or aspecting the 11th from Pada Lagna give gains by honest means.
inference: Tradition says lawful income.

meaning: Malefics joining or aspecting the 11th from Pada Lagna give gains by dishonest means.
inference: Tradition says income of doubtful ethics.

meaning: Benefics or exalted/moolatrikona planets in the 11th from Arudha Lagna give plenty of wealth by just means.
inference: Tradition says abundant, fair earnings.

meaning: Planets in the 12th from Lagna or Pada Lagna make spending exceed income.
inference: Tradition says the native overspends.

meaning: The same planets sitting in the 11th instead of the 12th from Lagna or Pada turn the loss into gain.
inference: Tradition says income instead of expense from those sources.

meaning: Moon, Jupiter or Venus in the 2nd from Pada Lagna make the native rich.
inference: Tradition says wealth.

meaning: An exalted planet in the 2nd from Pada Lagna makes the native rich.
inference: Tradition says wealth.

meaning: Arudha Lagna in a kendra or trikona from Janma Lagna or Karakamsa gives great wealth.
inference: Tradition says strong public image and riches.

meaning: Arudha Lagna and its 7th being free of obstructing argala makes the native fortunate.
inference: Tradition says smooth gains with no blockage.

meaning: Benefic argala on Arudha Lagna and its 7th gives abundant wealth.
inference: Tradition says strong support for earnings.

meaning: Malefics in benefic signs together with benefics in malefic signs indicate poverty.
inference: Tradition says shortage of money.

meaning: The 8th lord aspecting Lagna and Karaka Lagna indicates poverty.
inference: Tradition says need and struggle.

meaning: The 12th lord aspecting Lagna and Karaka Lagna makes a spendthrift.
inference: Tradition says wasteful spending.

meaning: If the lord of the dasa-starting lagna sign is exalted or debilitated, the native is wealthy and influential.
inference: Tradition says rank and money.

meaning: A lagna lord in a friendly sign in the dasa lagna gives moderate wealth.
inference: Tradition says average means.

meaning: A lagna lord outside those conditions leaves the native poor and distressed.
inference: Tradition says hardship in that dasa lagna.

meaning: The Atmakaraka in Libra navamsa earns much through trade.
inference: Tradition says commerce is a good income route.

meaning: Exalted or friendly planets in the 11th from Arudha Lagna give immense wealth.
inference: Tradition says very large gains.

meaning: Benefics joining or aspecting Arudha Lagna make the native wealthy.
inference: Tradition says material comfort.

meaning: The 7th-house arudha falling in kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Arudha Lagna gives much money and good fortune.
inference: Tradition says earnings and luck.

meaning: The 7th-house arudha in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Arudha Lagna makes money hard to get.
inference: Tradition says poverty or struggle.

meaning: The 8th lord from Atmakaraka (or Lagna) aspecting Atmakaraka (or Lagna) brings poverty.
inference: Tradition says financial hardship.

meaning: Benefics, the Arudha lord or yogakaraka planets on the 2nd from Arudha Lagna give good money prospects.
inference: Tradition says sound finances.

meaning: Atmakaraka or its sign lord aspecting or joining the 2nd lord from Atmakaraka is the best wealth link.
inference: Tradition says outstanding prosperity.

meaning: Moon and Venus in mutual aspect, Moon 3rd from Venus, or both in the 2nd house, bring vehicles and horses.
inference: Tradition says the native gets conveyances.

meaning: Moon and Venus aspecting the 4th from Karakamsa give fine, beautiful houses.
inference: Tradition says attractive homes.

meaning: Malefics in the 2nd from the dasa rasi mean money loss in that chara dasa.
inference: Tradition says expense during the period.

meaning: Moon and Venus in the 3rd from the dasa rasi give wealth in that dasa, in the 12th they cause loss.
inference: Tradition says gain or loss depending on the house.

meaning: With Karakamsa in Aries and Moon and Venus in its 4th, a Cancer dasa or bhukti can bring houses.
inference: Tradition says property purchase in that period.

meaning: Arudha Labha in Leo with the Sun there gives income from government or the father's estate.
inference: Tradition says earnings through state or inheritance from father.

meaning: Arudha Labha in Cancer with the Moon there gives income via mother or her property.
inference: Tradition says earnings tied to mother.

meaning: Arudha Labha in Taurus or Libra with Jupiter makes the spouse a working partner who earns.
inference: Tradition says the spouse adds to household income.

meaning: Planets in or aspecting the 11th from Pada Lagna make wealth, benefics by good means and malefics by bad means.
inference: Tradition says wealth whose quality follows the planets.

meaning: Moon, Venus or Jupiter in the 2nd from Pada Lagna make the native rich, while Ketu there brings early aging.
inference: Tradition says wealth, or early aging with Ketu.

meaning: The pada of the 7th house in a kendra or trikona from the ascendant makes wealthy; in 2,3,6,8,11,12 it makes poor.
inference: Tradition says rich or poor by the placement.

meaning: The 4th lord aspecting Atmakaraka or Ascendant gives happiness, the 8th poverty, 12th spending, and 3rd, 6th or 5th wisdom.
inference: Tradition says outcome depends on which lord aspects.

meaning: A nakshatra-dasa sign lord in lagna or fall makes rich, in a friend's house some wealth, otherwise misery.
inference: Tradition says wealth following the lord's dignity.

meaning: Atmakaraka or planets in Libra navamsa undervalue own worth, with money struggle and marriage hurdles if Venus-Ketu or Sun-Ketu afflict Libra.
inference: Tradition says low self-worth and difficulty before value is learned.

meaning: A Kalachakra dasa-pada jump from Pisces to Scorpio is listed as a fever time.
inference: Tradition says fever during that passage.

meaning: A Kalachakra jump from Virgo to Cancer is listed as a loss time for mother, relative or wife.
inference: Tradition says family bereavement risk.

meaning: A Kalachakra jump from Cancer to Leo indicates trouble from ulcers or wounds.
inference: Tradition says skin or wound illness.

meaning: A Kalachakra jump from Leo to Gemini indicates illness of the wife.
inference: Tradition says wife's health risk.

meaning: A Kalachakra jump from Sagittarius to Aries indicates loss of a son or like relative.
inference: Tradition says grief concerning a son.

meaning: If the house of Kalachakra passage holds a benefic there is no risk, with a malefic there is danger.
inference: Tradition says occupant decides safety.

meaning: A second reading of the Virgo to Cancer jump says the native grows great and travels north happily.
inference: Tradition says rise and a good trip.

meaning: A Kalachakra jump from Pisces to Scorpio is said elsewhere to remove troubles.
inference: Tradition says relief from difficulties.

meaning: A jump from Aries to Sagittarius brings prosperity, marriage and good events, plus royal favour with a benefic in transit.
inference: Tradition says auspicious growth.
variants: With benefic in house of transit

meaning: This lists the Deha and Jeeva lords of each Kalachakra chakra, with Savya order and the reverse for Apasavya.
inference: Tradition fixes which planets rule body and life in each sign group.

meaning: Mars, Saturn, Sun or Rahu in the Deha or Jeeva house is a warning, serious if several are there.
inference: Tradition says grave danger to life is feared.

meaning: A malefic in Deha or Jeeva means serious illness or great risk, and both houses occupied means the native suffers.
inference: Tradition says severe trouble.

meaning: Two, three or four malefics in Deha or Jeeva give a growing disease, a sudden loss, then the worst result.
inference: Tradition says rising severity with number.

meaning: Deha and Jeeva both held by one or two malefics bring danger from king or robbers, or worse.
inference: Tradition says threats from rulers or thieves.

meaning: Each planet badly placed in Deha or Jeeva gives its own harm such as fire, weapon, or stomach trouble.
inference: Tradition says a planet-specific danger.

meaning: Planets in certain houses are death-place positions, harmful when afflicted, weak or in enemy sign.
inference: Tradition says these placements raise risk.

meaning: The Sun in Deha or Jeeva gives loss of wealth, fever, enemies and bilious ailments.
inference: Tradition says several troubles.

meaning: Mars badly placed in Deha or Jeeva gives inflammation, fire, quarrels and loss of land.
inference: Tradition says conflict and heat troubles.

meaning: Saturn in Deha or Jeeva gives quarrels, pain and losses of family and trade.
inference: Tradition says hardship in many areas.

meaning: Rahu in Deha brings enemies, wandering and danger from a king.
inference: Tradition says restless, threatened life.

meaning: Ketu in Deha brings thieves, fire, bleeding and poverty.
inference: Tradition says loss of place and relations.

meaning: A chakradasa of the lagna sign with benefic sign and planet gives health, children, wealth and fame.
inference: Tradition says an exceedingly happy period.

meaning: A chakradasa of lagna with a planet there in own, exalted or friendly sign gives rank and royal honour.
inference: Tradition says dominion and wealth.

meaning: A chakradasa of lagna with a debilitated, combust or enemy-placed planet brings loss of family.
inference: Tradition says loss of children, wife and valued things.

meaning: The chakradasa of an auspicious 2nd sign increases grain, wealth, family and speech.
inference: Tradition says growth of resources and learning.

meaning: The chakradasa of a good 3rd sign brings food, courage and ornaments.
inference: Tradition says happiness and dignity.

meaning: The chakradasa of a good 4th sign brings vehicles, new land, pilgrimage and home.
inference: Tradition says comfort and property.

meaning: The Kalachakra chakradasa of the 5th sign from lagna brings royal-type rewards, but a movable sign can cost position.
inference: Good for status, family, wealth and vehicles; movable sign gives a mixed loss of position.
variants: Same for a fixed or dual 5th sign without the loss clause

meaning: When the 6th-sign chakradasa runs in a malefic sign, enemies, debts, accidents and illness are threatened.
inference: Bad period for conflict, debt and health trouble; a benefic sign softens it to mixed.

meaning: The 7th-sign chakradasa in a benefic sign with a benefic planet gives marriage and prosperity.
inference: Good for marriage, children, livestock wealth and honour.
variants: Malefic 7th sign with malefic planet reverses it

meaning: The 8th-sign chakradasa in a malefic sign with a malefic planet brings misery and losses.
inference: Bad for wealth, relations, stomach trouble and enemies.
variants: Benefic sign with benefic planet gives milder result

meaning: The 9th-sign chakradasa gives good results if the sign is favourable, otherwise the results turn the other way.
inference: Good for children, wealth, charity and support from powerful people when the sign is propitious; bad otherwise.

meaning: A propitious 10th-sign chakradasa gives authority, fame and a happy family.
inference: Good for career, rank and health.

meaning: The 11th-sign chakradasa with good planets in it gives gains and comforts.
inference: Good for income, property, children and official favour.
variants: Malefic planets in the 11th sign reduce gains

meaning: The 12th-sign chakradasa in a malefic sign brings bodily suffering, loss and poverty.
inference: Bad for health, place, farming income and relations with authority.

meaning: If the lord of a chakradasa sign is strong by exaltation, friendly or own varga, with friends and benefic aspects, that dasha is good.
inference: Good results for the whole life area of that sign during its chakradasa.
variants: Same test using the navamsa dignity of the lord

meaning: If the chakradasa sign lord is debilitated, in an enemy sign, combust, or in 6/8/12 with malefic aspects, the dasha is painful.
inference: Bad results for the life area of that sign during its chakradasa.
variants: Any one afflicting condition gives a partial effect

meaning: When the dasa sign lord is in a movable sign or movable navamsa and the chakra begins from a movable sign, the native travels abroad.
inference: Foreign residence for as long as the chakra runs.
variants: Check the lord in a movable navamsa only

meaning: Simhavalokana (the Kalachakra lion-glance sign jump) falling in the dasa of a weak or ill-placed malefic gives danger events.
inference: Fever, loss of place or a dear person, and accidents with water, fire, weapons or vehicles.

meaning: Mandukagamana, the Kalachakra frog-leap jump of the dasa sign, marks danger at that moment.
inference: Loss of an elder or parent, and risk from poison, weapon, fire or fever.

meaning: A Mandukagati jump between Leo and Gemini is said to hurt the mother or the native.
inference: Danger to mother or self, long fever and trouble from rulers or enemies.

meaning: Simhavalokana occurring in the savya (direct) Kalachakra gives danger from animals or fire.
inference: Risk from four-legged animals or fire in that dasha step.
variants: Apasavya version is Simhavalokana in apasavya chakra

meaning: Prishtatogamana (backward sign step) in the savya chakra costs wealth and may harm the father.
inference: Loss of wealth, grain and cattle, illness or death of father.

meaning: Mandukaplutim (frog jump) in the apasavya chakra brings illness to wife and children and danger from enemies.
inference: Family illness, severe fever, loss of place and danger from beasts.

meaning: Simhavalokana in the apasavya chakra threatens loss of place and the father.
inference: Loss of position or the father in that dasha step.
variants: Savya chakra version gives danger from animals or fire

meaning: Prishtatogamana in the apasavya chakra gives water danger, loss of father and trouble with rulers.
inference: Water accidents, loss of place, fall from favour and fleeing to the jungle.

meaning: In KP, a 10th cusp sub lord signifying houses 2, 6, 10 or 11 promises employment, with 6 pointing to service.
inference: Good for getting a job; 6 leans to service, 7 leans to business.

meaning: A 10th cusp sub lord mainly signifying 1, 5, 9 or 12 gives career delay or dissatisfaction.
inference: Bad for job stability; breaks and unhappiness at work.

meaning: In KP, a job change shows when houses 5 and 9 (leaving the old job) and 2, 6, 10, 11 (new job) are active.
inference: Job change is timed by the periods of significators of these houses.

meaning: A transfer with the same employer is read from houses 3, 10 and 12 in KP.
inference: Transfer is timed by periods of significators of 3, 10, 12.

meaning: KP takes houses 2, 6, 10 with the Sun as chief governor for service or profession.
inference: Service life is judged from these houses; job change 1, 5, 9; transfer 3, 10, 12.

meaning: KP takes houses 2, 7, 10 for independent business, with the 7th as main house.
inference: Business life is judged from the 2nd, 7th and 10th cusps.
variants: Business avoids 6 in the sub lord signification

meaning: Retirement from service happens when joint period rulers are significators of 1, 5, 9, 12.
inference: Service ends in the dasha-bhukti-antara of significators of these houses.

meaning: A 10th or 6th cusp sub lord that signifies 2, 6 or 10 means earning from profession or service.
inference: Good for livelihood through employment.
variants: Applies to 2nd cusp sub lord for income

meaning: When the star lord of the dasha or bhukti ruler is retrograde, the period shows ups and downs.
inference: Mixed career with promotions followed by reversions.
variants: Star lord of the antara ruler retrograde

meaning: A 5th cusp sub lord that is a primary significator of 2, 5 or 11 promises children.
inference: Good for having children; timing is examined only after this promise.

meaning: KP takes 2, 5, 11 for child birth, with 5 for a woman and 11 for a man, and Jupiter as natural significator.
inference: Children are judged from these houses; 1, 4, 10 mean no child.

meaning: A 5th cusp sub lord signifying 2, 5 or 11 promises birth of a child.
inference: Good for children; signifying 1, 4, 10 denies it.
variants: Female uses 5 first, male uses 11 first

meaning: If a dasha ruler signifies both 2,5,11 and 1,4,10, the sub period decides whether a child is born or lost.
inference: Child birth in the sub period of a 2,5,11 significator; separation in that of a 1,4,10 significator.

meaning: KP judges education from 4, 9, 11 with 9 for higher study and 6 for competitive exams.
inference: Education is judged from these houses with Mercury and Jupiter as governors.

meaning: A dasha ruler signifying the 9th whose sub lord owns the 8th ends studies in that period.
inference: Studies are dropped; a sub lord tied to 4, 9, 11 continues them.

meaning: A 4th cusp sub lord that is Mercury or Jupiter, or in the star of a 4/9/11 planet linked to them, gives academic qualification.
inference: Good for degrees and formal education.

meaning: KP reads foreign travel or settlement from houses 3, 9 and 12, with 9 plus 12 for study abroad.
inference: Foreign travel is judged from these houses.

meaning: KP takes 3, 9, 12 for foreign travel with the Moon as chief governor; 3, 9, 11 for return.
inference: Travel abroad judged from 3, 9, 12; return home from 3, 9, 11.

meaning: KP divides the zodiac into signs, then stars of 13 deg 20 min, then unequal subs, then sub-subs.
inference: No prediction; it explains the KP division scheme.

meaning: Sub lengths in a nakshatra follow Vimshottari years, starting with the star lord, each sub being years/120 of 13 deg 20 min.
inference: No prediction; a calculation table.
variants: Venus sub is 20/120 of a star

meaning: The KP table has 249 subs because 6 subs cross sign boundaries and count twice.
inference: No prediction; it explains the 249 numbering.

meaning: Each sub is split again in Vimshottari ratio to give 2187 sub-sub divisions.
inference: No prediction; a division fact.

meaning: KP uses the Krishnamurti ayanamsa, about 6 arc minutes from Lahiri, with Placidus cusps.
inference: No prediction; a setting fact. Our engine default stays Lahiri.

meaning: KP ranks significators of a house in four levels: planets in star of occupant, the occupant, planets in star of owner, the owner.
inference: Planet strength for a house falls in that order; star-based links are stronger than sign-based.
variants: Extended with conjoined and aspecting planets as weaker levels

meaning: The astrosage-style KP method says a planet signifies houses it occupies and owns, and its star lord and sub lord refine this.
inference: Signification is built from planet, star lord and sub lord in steps.
variants: Planets within 3.33 degrees count as conjunct

meaning: In KP the star lord shows the kind of result and the sub lord decides whether it happens.
inference: General KP principle; no direct chart test.

meaning: If a cusp sub lord signifies the supporting houses of a matter, the matter is promised and more such houses make it stronger.
inference: Good result for that life area.
variants: Count of supporting houses as strength

meaning: A cusp sub lord signifying mainly the 12th-from (opposing) houses denies, delays or troubles the matter.
inference: Bad or delayed result for that life area.

meaning: KP timing steps: confirm promise, list significators, match dasha-bhukti-antara, confirm with ruling planets and transits.
inference: Event timing is accepted only when promise and periods agree.
variants: Sookshma level as an extra check

meaning: KP ruling planets are the lagna lord, lagna star and sub lords, Moon sign, star and sub lords, and weekday lord.
inference: Repeating ruling planets that are also significators are strongest for timing.

meaning: In KP horary, the number 1 to 249 picks a sub whose start degree becomes the ascendant for the question.
inference: No prediction; a method for casting the horary chart.

meaning: The KP horary reading steps pick the matter cusp, read its sub lord and star lord, and confirm with ruling planets.
inference: Favourable houses mean yes, opposing mean no, mixed means delay.

meaning: A KP cusp lying within a few arc minutes of a sub boundary needs confirmation by birth time checking.
inference: Birth time errors can change the sub lord and the verdict.

meaning: The source says KP suits yes-or-no and timing questions while Parashari suits life quality and remedies.
inference: Opinion on when to use which method.

meaning: The cuspal sub lord promises or denies a matter, and results come only in the joint period of its significators.
inference: Core KP rule; promise first, then timing.

meaning: A significator planet gives in its dasha the results of houses held or owned by its star lord, good if its sub lord agrees.
inference: Results follow the star lord houses, helped or spoilt by the sub lord.

meaning: Significators of a house rank: planet in star of occupant, occupant, planet in star of owner, owner, then conjunct or aspecting ones.
inference: Star-based significators are stronger than sign-based ones.

meaning: Rahu and Ketu act as agents of the planets they join or are aspected by and the lord of their sign.
inference: Nodes give results of their agent planets in a fixed order.
variants: Node in star of a planet gives that planet results

meaning: A planet placed in the star of Rahu or Ketu signifies the matters of the node agency.
inference: That planet carries the node results.

meaning: A planet gives mostly results of the house it occupies, then houses it owns, with angles stronger than succedent and cadent houses.
inference: Houses of occupation outweigh ownership; angles outweigh others.

meaning: A planet linked to the lord of 6, 8 or 12 by occupation, star, conjunction or aspect is weakened.
inference: Afflicted planet gives poor results.
variants: Own or exalted planet resists this

meaning: In KP, two planets are connected if one is in the sign, star or sub of the other, or they conjoin or aspect.
inference: No prediction; defines planetary connection.

meaning: For each matter there are harmonious houses and detrimental houses, which are the 12th-from group.
inference: A sub lord linked to harmonious houses supports the matter and one linked to detrimental houses denies it.

meaning: An event happens in the joint period of dasha, bhukti and antara lords that signify the matter houses.
inference: Timing needs all period levels to agree with the matter.
variants: Add sookshma as a fourth level

meaning: A significator whose sub lord suits the matter shown by its star lord gives favourable results in its period.
inference: Good if sub lord is harmonious, bad if detrimental.

meaning: A planet good for the native may be bad for his father or mother, so relatives are judged from their own house counts.
inference: Father is read from the 9th house and mother from the 4th.

meaning: No planet or house is wholly good or bad in KP; the star and sub link to the matter decides.
inference: General KP principle against fixed benefic and malefic labels.

meaning: When a house has too many significators, KP removes weak ones: give Rahu/Ketu priority and drop planets with detrimental sub lords.
inference: Helps shortlist the planets that really act.

meaning: A table of how long each planet stays in a nakshatra: Saturn about 13 months, Moon about 24 hours.
inference: No prediction; used for transit timing.

meaning: A transiting planet in the star area of a natal significator of a house influences that house matters.
inference: Transit triggers events of the houses the significator signifies.
variants: Sub lord of transit decides good or bad

meaning: A transiting planet in the star of the running dasha lords, with a harmless sub lord, repeats the joint period results.
inference: Transit confirms the timing within the dasha.

meaning: Sun spends 1-3 days and Moon about 3 hours in a sub, so they fix the day and hour of an event.
inference: No prediction; explains fine timing by Sun and Moon.

meaning: If the cuspal sub lord signifies that house or its matter houses, the matter is promised, and denial houses deny it.
inference: Promise is read from the cusp sub lord signification.

meaning: Results occur in the joint dasha of matter significators only when the cusp sub lord has promised the matter.
inference: Promise is a precondition to timing.

meaning: Ruling planets at judgment time are the day lord, lagna sign and star lords, Moon sign and star lords, with nodes added under conditions.
inference: No direct prediction; a method list with preference order.
variants: Preference order lagna star lord first

meaning: When ruling planets coincide with significators of the matter, the event happens in their period.
inference: Used to confirm timing and rectify birth time.

meaning: The Moon star, sub and sub-sub lords at birth give the dasha, bhukti and antara ruler at birth.
inference: No prediction; shows how the birth dasha is derived.

meaning: Two planets in the same sign with same star and sub lord are separated by the sub-sub lord.
inference: The one whose sub-sub lord owns good houses does better.

meaning: If the star lord of the dasha or bhukti ruler sits 6, 8 or 12 from its own sign, it does not give the star lord house results well.
inference: Weak delivery of promised results in that period.

meaning: A planet and its star lord in a 6/8 relation give only ordinary temporary rise in their period.
inference: Results fall short of the hoped level.

meaning: Joint period rulers in reception, conjunction or mutual aspect affect each other affairs.
inference: Linked rulers combine their results.

meaning: Joint period rulers give results of houses owned by their star lords, scaled by star lord strength.
inference: Strong star lords give better results.

meaning: A 6th cusp sub lord not signifying 6, 8 or 12 means good health; illness begins in periods of 6/8/12 significators with an afflicted lagna.
inference: Good health when 6th sub lord is clean; illness risk in the stated periods.

meaning: Recovery is timed by dasha-bhukti of significators of 1, 5, 11 that avoid 6, 8, 12.
inference: Recovery is expected in those periods.

meaning: KP reads longevity from houses 1, 8 and 3 with Saturn as chief governor, and marakas from 12, 7, 2.
inference: Life span is judged from these houses as a tradition claim.

meaning: The badhaka house is 11th for movable lagna, 9th for fixed and 7th for dual, and is considered before maraka.
inference: Badhaka is seen as more harmful than maraka in this school.

meaning: KP reads health from the lagna, disease from the 6th and cure from 1, 5, 11, with 8 and 12 for accidents.
inference: Health, illness and recovery are judged from these houses.
variants: Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu for accidents

meaning: A planet in the star of the 6th lord with sub lord tied to the 8th gives chronic disease in its dasha.
inference: Long-lasting illness in that period even if career is helped.

meaning: The joint period of badhaka and maraka significators counted from a relative house marks that relative death.
inference: Danger period for father (from 9th) or mother (from 4th).

meaning: Transiting planets in stars of 6th house significators whose sub lords tie to 6 or 8 give ill health.
inference: Worse during a matching dasha.

meaning: The sub lord of the lagna cusp owning 6, 8 or 12 gives short life, 1/5/9/10 long life, mixed gives middle.
inference: A tradition claim about life length bands, not a prediction here.

meaning: A lagna sub lord signifying badhaka and maraka houses, or 3rd and 8th sub lords doing so, is poor for long life.
inference: Tradition claim of reduced life length.

meaning: A lagna sub lord in the star of occupant of 1 or 11 gives normal health, and 6/8/12 gives poor health.
inference: Good or poor health by star link.

meaning: A lagna or 8th cusp sub lord in the star of an occupant or owner of 8 or 12 shows accidents.
inference: Accident danger; survival depends on 2, 7, 11 links.

meaning: A 7th cusp sub lord signifying 2, 7 or 11 promises marriage.
inference: Good for marriage; some need both 7 and 11.
variants: Read via star lord of the sub lord

meaning: A 7th cusp sub lord mainly signifying 1, 6 or 10 obstructs or delays marriage.
inference: Delay in marriage; 12 shows separation.
variants: Saturn on 7th cusp read as late marriage

meaning: A 5th cusp sub lord linked to 7 or 11, with 5 and 7 connected, suggests a love marriage.
inference: A tendency to love marriage only.

meaning: KP takes 2, 7, 11 for marriage with Venus as chief governor and 1, 6, 10 for separation.
inference: Marriage is judged from these houses.

meaning: A dasha ruler signifying the 7th whose sub lord signifies 1, 6 or 10 gives no marriage in that period.
inference: Marriage does not happen then; if sub lord signifies 2, 7, 11 it does.

meaning: A 7th cusp sub lord that signifies 2, 7 or 11 means the native will marry.
inference: Marriage promised; 1, 6, 10 means no marriage.

meaning: KP takes 4, 11, 12 for buying or building property and 3, 5, 10 for selling.
inference: Property deals are judged from these houses; Mars for buildings, Saturn for land.

meaning: If the 4th cusp sub lord sits in the star of an occupant or owner of house 4, 11 or 12 and Mars or Saturn is linked, a building is promised.
inference: KP says the native owns a building of his own; property, good.

meaning: If the 10th cusp sub lord signifies houses 3 or 10, the native is shown parting with a building.
inference: KP reads sale of property; property, mixed to bad.

meaning: When a troublesome house is running in dasha, doing that house's kind of work softens its harm.
inference: Charity for the 12th and research or technical work for the 8th reduce the bad result; remedy, good.

meaning: When houses 8 and 12 both are significators in the running dasha-bhukti-antara chain, the period is painful.
inference: KP reads loss, suffering and heavy expense; setback, bad.
variants: 8th alone: pain; 12th linked to 8th: drastic loss

meaning: The Fortuna point (Lagna plus Moon minus Sun) falls in some house, and that house shows where money comes from.
inference: Wealth arrives through that house's matters and through planets making 30, 60 or 120 degree aspects to it; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 1st house links money to the self.
inference: Wealth and luck come through own effort; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 2nd house sits in the house of savings and family.
inference: Large wealth, healthy bank balance and strong family ties; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 3rd house ties money to the house of short trips and communication.
inference: Income through short travel, commission, agency work or writing; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 4th house ties money to home, land and learning.
inference: Gains from property investment and education; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 5th house ties money to creativity and speculation.
inference: Money from sports, films, music or speculation, and children bring luck; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 6th house ties money to service and daily work.
inference: Earnings from servants, pets or small-scale banking; wealth, mixed.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 7th house ties money to partners.
inference: Gains through partnership and the opposite sex, and marriage lifts finances; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 8th house ties money to shared and hidden resources.
inference: Money through spouse, inheritance and insurance; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 9th house ties money to teachers and fortune.
inference: Gains via guru, long journeys and higher study; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 10th house ties money to career.
inference: Income from any profession with support from authority or government; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 11th house ties money to the house of gains.
inference: Gains through friends and fulfilled money wishes; wealth, good.

meaning: Fortuna point in the 12th house ties money to outflow and the unseen.
inference: Investments tend to be lucky, money from unknown sources, and detachment helps; wealth, mixed.

meaning: Lists which houses are used in KP for money gain, lottery and speculation, and names Jupiter as the chief money planet.
inference: Reference list only: gain 2,6,11; lottery 2,3,6,11; speculation 2,5,6,11.

meaning: When the period ruler signifies 2, 6 and 11 (6 for loans received, 7 for the lender) and the sub lord agrees, money or a loan comes in that period.
inference: KP reads receipt of money or loan; houses 8 and 12 instead mean repayment or loss; wealth, good.

meaning: A case where Rahu in a Pisces 10th, afflicted Jupiter and a bad annual chart in year 54 led to jail for embezzlement, with bail in year 55.
inference: Lal Kitab links an afflicted 10th and annual Rahu in the 12th to legal trouble at work; career, bad.

meaning: A well-placed Jupiter in the 10th gives a rich, debt-free person with high government standing, with sign-wise extras.
inference: Good Jupiter in 10th brings status and wealth; Cancer helps siblings, Scorpio father and politics, Pisces income; career, good.

meaning: A bad Sun in the 10th is said to reduce father's happiness and cause repeated setbacks in work.
inference: Failure, eye trouble and ups and downs; remedies are white cap, avoiding black clothes and feeding the blind; career, bad.
variants: Sun bad in 10th in Gemini: foreign-travel loss
Sun bad in 10th in Libra: business loss
Sun bad in 10th in Aquarius: low mother's happiness

meaning: Mercury in the 10th gives a clever, sweet-spoken traveller when good, and weaker results in some signs when bad.
inference: Good: wit, sea travel, knowledge of conduct; bad in Aries, Leo or Sagittarius hurts siblings, income or marriage; career, mixed.
variants: Mercury good in 10th in Gemini: father and government gain
Mercury bad in 10th in Leo: low income
Mercury bad in 10th in Sagittarius: poor marriage

meaning: A real-life case where the author warned a builder with an afflicted 4th lord in the 6th to leave his line, and the capital was lost.
inference: Illustrates that an afflicted 4th lord in the 6th harms capital in building work; career, bad.

meaning: Moon in the 10th house of a Lal Kitab chart is read for long life, medical-line fame and sensitive habits.
inference: Long life near 90, wealth if houses 2 and 4 are empty, and troubles from night milk; remedies are worship and avoiding liquor; career, mixed.
variants: Moon in 10th with houses 2 and 4 empty

meaning: Two or more mutually hostile planets in the 10th, or Sun in 4th with Saturn in 7th, make a blind (andha) chart.
inference: Clash of planets gives unstable work, unemployment and money strain; remedy is feeding blind people; career, bad.
variants: Sun and Rahu in 10th with Saturn in 4th

meaning: A Venus line running toward Mercury and not cut by the Sun line is read as supportive for Mercury.
inference: Palmistry says manual work, mental work and trade go well; career, good.

meaning: Mars acting as a benefic together with the Sun gives a minister-like, protected person.
inference: Many enemies but subdued, gain from timber trade and about 28 years of service; career, good.

meaning: Mercury is said to bring good luck at age 23 and Mars at age 31.
inference: Fortune is expected to open at those ages; career, good.

meaning: The 10th is a doubly malefic house, so a planet there is doubtful and doubly strong, and it sleeps if the 2nd is empty.
inference: Awakens when Saturn transits the 2nd; career, mixed.
variants: H10 planet dormant when H2 blank
H10 awakens on Saturn transit of H2

meaning: A planet in the 10th of the annual chart is doubtful, first giving good then bad results.
inference: Becomes doubly malefic if the 8th and 2nd are equally occupied; remedy is feeding 10 blind people; career, mixed.
variants: annual H10 planet with H8 and H2 both occupied

meaning: An empty 10th house gives bodily strength but stops planets in the 4th from giving good results.
inference: Strong body, blocked 4th-house planets; remedy is meeting parents; career, mixed.
variants: empty H10 with planet in H4

meaning: A table of trades by planet and house, such as Jupiter 4th gold or Saturn 6th engineering and coal.
inference: Each planet in the named house points to that occupation; career, neutral.
variants: Saturn in H6: engineering, coal, stone

meaning: A table of service-job types per planet with income units valued in 1952 rupees.
inference: Reference table; the money values are historical and not testable.

meaning: Saturn's 10th-house results: shrewd, wealth through clever sight, magic power, long-lived father, with Saturn's age 90 shortened by other planets.
inference: Cunning and building-material or public-work gains; longevity cut by Sun, Moon, Mars and Ketu periods; career, mixed.
variants: Saturn age 90 cut by Sun 7, Moon 8, Mars 9 years

meaning: A fate line that starts alone like a staff and apart from the life line is read in palmistry.
inference: Self-made life with struggle and no helpers; career, mixed.

meaning: A fate line starting from the head line is read as mental effort leading to comfort.
inference: Comfort from about age 34 by own brain work; career, good.

meaning: Where a fate line joined to the life line leans decides the age self-earning starts.
inference: Ages given per finger direction from 16 to 60; career, neutral.
variants: lean between ring and little finger: 22

meaning: Shapes at the end of the heart line are read for government service.
inference: Triangle gives government job, square full pay, upward branches progress, downward weakness; career, mixed.

meaning: A single unbranched head line is read as a greedy, wandering nature.
inference: Restless and greedy; a Mercury-ward fork adds trading gain but untruthfulness; career, mixed.

meaning: Where the head line forks decides the result, such as Mercury and Sun for business success.
inference: Sun-Saturn fork gives property, Jupiter fork is bad, Moon fork brings self-destructive worry; career, mixed.

meaning: A life-line branch that joins the fate line shows a partner whose arrival awakens fortune.
inference: Luck rises after marriage; career, good.

meaning: A rule-of-thumb formula for monthly income as years of service times 7.5 rupees, with age bands for earning and saving.
inference: Describes a historic income pattern by age; not chart-testable.

meaning: A strong Mercury as year lord of the annual chart brings gain and exam success.
inference: Great gains, sharper mind, civil service and writing success that year; career, good.

meaning: A medium-strength Mercury as year lord gives moderate but real success.
inference: Business success, respect among friends and exam skill that year; career, good.

meaning: Saturn alone in the 10th gives honour and long life, with every third year good.
inference: Wealth, honour and a long-lived father, but a fall at the end if only pious; career, good.
variants: Saturn alone in 10th in own sign
Saturn in 10th with Jupiter and Venus in 2nd

meaning: When Saturn is bad in the 10th, feeding blind people and trimming beard in bad work spells helps.
inference: Remedy via Jupiter's help eases work trouble; career, good.

meaning: Rahu strong in a good house gives political success and rule over printing, photography and cement.
inference: Success in politics and Rahu trades; career, good.

meaning: A good Mars after age 39 makes the person an adviser protected from enemies.
inference: Gains in wood trade from age 39; career, good.

meaning: A bad Mars in the 10th gives about 15 years of sorrow and a mystic bent.
inference: Hardship, interest in magic and charms; career, bad.

meaning: Garbled line on Mars's 7th aspect with Venus-Mercury, Saturn and Jupiter in the 10th.
inference: Unclear from the text.

meaning: Ketu in the 1st in a good sign gives a hardworking, happy and wealthy person.
inference: Wealth and happiness; if Ketu reaches the 1st in the annual chart, far travel; career, good.
variants: Ketu in 1st in annual chart: travel

meaning: Ketu in the 8th of the birth or annual chart brings a job transfer or change against wish.
inference: The change feels forced but turns out beneficial later; career, mixed.

meaning: Two or more enemy planets in the 10th with an afflicted Moon stop work from settling.
inference: Frequent job changes; career, bad.

meaning: Two or more enemy planets in the 10th with a good Moon run several professions together.
inference: Multiple careers grow side by side; career, good.

meaning: A weak Saturn, or Saturn's enemies in houses 8, 10 and 11, makes work unstable.
inference: Unsettled profession; Lal Kitab counts Kaal Purush signs here; career, bad.

meaning: Lal Kitab holds that any planet in the 10th acts at double strength.
inference: Doubly good or doubly bad outcomes; career, mixed.

meaning: A forehead about a quarter of the face length is good and a wider one is luckier.
inference: Physical sign for luck; character, good.

meaning: Face width two-thirds of length is lucky, and long or wide faces differ by sex.
inference: Long face and mouth lucky for men, wide faces for women; character, mixed.

meaning: Marks on the feet such as conch, wheel or elephant eye are read like hand marks.
inference: Wheel means prosperity, elephant eye on right sole a throne, on left a robber; character, mixed.

meaning: Thumb length, thickness and phalanges are tied to Rahu-Ketu in the 2nd house.
inference: Long thumb more lust but control, thick spendthrift, short obstinate; character, mixed.

meaning: A palm with no lines, too many lines or very broad lines is read as a sign of planet condition.
inference: No lines hard-hearted, many lines ill-fated, broad lines clashing aspects; character, bad.

meaning: The planet that shows most in a person's nature gives house-9 results wherever it sits.
inference: Stronger planet drives habits, e.g. strong Sun more salt, weak Mars more sweets; character, neutral.

meaning: A hand with no lines at all is read as marking a hard-hearted, dacoit-like person.
inference: Harsh character; character, bad.

meaning: A hand covered with too many lines marks an unlucky, doubtful person.
inference: Ill fortune and suspicion; character, bad.

meaning: A line from the Moon mount running into Venus keeps the person from family love.
inference: Either a powerful fakir or an addict, in both cases away from worldly love; character, mixed.

meaning: The thumb is the hand's pivot and Venus's seat, and its link with other fingers changes results.
inference: Joined to Jupiter gives Jupiter-Venus results, to Mercury marriage and children, to Saturn protects sight; character, mixed.

meaning: A crow sign on the palm is tied to Sun, Saturn and Venus in the 12th.
inference: Dishonest nature; character, bad.

meaning: A swing sign on the palm goes with negative Mars and Saturn.
inference: Thief-like dishonesty, with Mars in 4th and Saturn in 1st; character, bad.

meaning: A bow sign on the palm goes with positive Mars and Saturn.
inference: Brave and courageous; character, good.

meaning: A count of 22 to 32 yavs (grain marks) is tied to Saturn in the 12th, though the table is doubtful.
inference: Renunciation of worldly life; character, neutral.

meaning: A count of 17 yavs is tied to Moon in the 2nd.
inference: Rich but poorly reputed and untrustworthy; character, mixed.

meaning: A count of 19 yavs is tied to Moon in the 4th.
inference: Religious and respected by rulers; character, good.

meaning: A count of 13 yavs is tied to Moon in the 6th, with uncertain table order.
inference: Wealthy but troubled home life; character, mixed.

meaning: A count of 18 yavs marks a gentle nature.
inference: Good-natured person; character, good.

meaning: A count of 15 yavs marks a criminal streak.
inference: Thief, dacoit and vices; character, bad.

meaning: A count of 22 yavs is read as a malefic Moon effect.
inference: Moon-linked troubles; character, bad.

meaning: Phrenology: the skull's 42 divisions map to the 12 houses and Rahu's 42 years.
inference: Planets in houses activate matching traits, set by age 7; character, neutral.

meaning: A benefic Rahu in the 11th gives pride and self-made wealth.
inference: Refuses parents' help and earns alone; character, good.

meaning: Malefic planets in both the 2nd and 7th houses show a violent tendency around age 50.
inference: Dacoit or murderer streak; character, bad.
variants: malefics in H2 and H7 at age 50

meaning: A dominant Jupiter shapes a clean, royal-spoken person with a long first finger.
inference: Good conduct, no asthma; character, good.

meaning: A dominant Sun gives a tall, wheatish person with lion-like eyes.
inference: Calm outside, angry inside; character, mixed.

meaning: A dominant Moon gives a milk-fair, broad-faced, soft-spoken person.
inference: Gentle and fond of white dress; character, good.

meaning: A dominant Venus gives a curd-fair, round-faced, romantic person.
inference: Fond of comfort and women's dress; character, mixed.

meaning: A dominant positive Mars gives red lion-like eyes and a heavy upper body.
inference: Bold physical type; character, good.

meaning: A dominant negative Mars gives a tall, hefty, loud person.
inference: Aggressive and ferocious; character, bad.

meaning: A dominant Mercury gives a glib talker with nervous pigeon-like eyes.
inference: Lacks leadership but loves beauty; character, mixed.

meaning: A dominant Saturn gives a dark, thin-browed, snake-tempered loner.
inference: Obstinate and solitary; character, bad.

meaning: A dominant Rahu gives a prominent chin and elephant-skin colour.
inference: Destructive, hungry, loyal to place not person; character, bad.

meaning: A dominant Ketu gives a protruding forehead and heavy thighs.
inference: Kind-hearted; character, good.

meaning: A benefic Jupiter in the 1st rises through diligence with mother's backing until 51.
inference: Honour from 16, own earning from 27, every 8th year bad; mother's loss near 51; character, mixed.

meaning: A malefic Jupiter in the 7th gives a loose life and old-age neglect if children are ignored.
inference: Filthy habits, no help from brothers if Jupiter polluted; remedy is gold or yellow cloth; character, bad.
variants: Jupiter dormant in blank H1 or H2
Saturn or Mercury in H2,6,12: wait for son till 45

meaning: Jupiter in the 10th with Moon in the 4th or Saturn in the 1st, 4th or 10th brings blame for helping.
inference: Punished for charity and blamed by others; character, bad.
variants: Jupiter in H10 with Moon in H4
Jupiter in H10 with Saturn in H1
Jupiter in H10 with Saturn in H4

meaning: Saturn in the 1st with a negative Mars gives a thief-like, burnt-faced person.
inference: Dishonest and unattractive; character, bad.

meaning: A malefic Saturn first shows as liquor addiction, fraud and liaisons.
inference: Dishonesty and vice with fondness for black things; character, bad.

meaning: The thumb's three phalanges stand for will, reasoning and love, and for childhood, youth and old age.
inference: Nail phalanx will, middle logic, base instinct; same logic for other fingers; character, neutral.

meaning: A longer thumb keeps sensual urges under control.
inference: Better control of passion; character, good.

meaning: A thin thumb tip shows weaker courage and a thick tip a stubborn, hardworking nature.
inference: Thin tip timid, thick tip determined; character, mixed.

meaning: A small knot at the base of the thumb favours magic and following others.
inference: Inclined to mantra and becomes a follower; character, mixed.

meaning: Forehead one quarter of face length and face two-thirds wide are lucky proportions.
inference: Wider forehead gives sympathy and status; wide face with narrow forehead gives selfishness; character, mixed.

meaning: A wide face is read as giving the lower mind compartments (7 to 12) more weight than the upper ones.
inference: Tradition says such a person is driven by selfish urges and has less intellect, while a longer face shows more sympathy.

meaning: A person with exactly 32 teeth is said to have speech that comes true even when spoken carelessly.
inference: Tradition advises others not to torment this person and the person to control anger; linked to house 3 of the kundli.

meaning: Having 31 teeth is linked to the 4th house of the kundli and called honourable.
inference: Tradition says this tooth count gives a good, respected result in life.

meaning: A black tongue and palate in a man, especially with round deep dark snake-like eyes, is tied to Ketu.
inference: Tradition claims childlessness or child loss, poor marital happiness, family disrepute and self-ruin, with his words coming true strongly.
variants: with snake-like round deep dark eyes

meaning: Hand shapes and finger-tip shapes (smooth, square, pointed, psychic, logical, mixed) each give a different temperament.
inference: Tradition reads smooth hands as hardworking, square as ruler-like, pointed as beauty-loving, psychic as religious, and long thumb with square tips as quarrelsome.
variants: short thumb mixed hand: cattle farming

meaning: Hardness, softness, size and length of the hand are used to judge ability and luck.
inference: Hard hand points to ruling ability, soft to comfort seeking, small hand to servitude, and short hands and feet to selfishness.

meaning: A long and round palm is a favourable palm shape.
inference: Tradition says the owner becomes a ruler-type person who is prosperous and comfortable.

meaning: A long palm stretch between the Mercury and Moon areas, or a palm that juts past the little finger, shows more speech reach.
inference: Tradition links this to stronger speech power and wider influence over others.

meaning: A long palm zone at the finger roots between Jupiter and Mercury marks a stable Mercury mount.
inference: Tradition reads this as greater mental power.

meaning: A long palm area from Venus to the Moon is taken as strong Venus.
inference: Tradition says such a person has stronger sensual desires.

meaning: A long stretch from the Venus root to the end of Jupiter, called the Mars-nek zone, shows a strong thumb.
inference: Tradition says this gives more personal courage and a good Mars-nek effect.

meaning: Gaps between particular finger pairs (thumb-index, index-middle, middle-ring, ring-little) are each tied to a planet pair and a trait.
inference: Tradition reads these gaps as courage, thought power, freedom of thought with shifting stance, and self-earning respectively.
variants: middle-ring gap Saturn-Sun: freedom of thought

meaning: The length of the index finger, very long or short, is read for power and jealousy.
inference: Tradition says a very long index finger gives rule and power, while a short one gives jealousy and baseless thoughts.

meaning: An unusually short or long middle finger, and a very short ring finger, mark particular characters.
inference: Tradition links a short middle finger to a reclusive ascetic, a very long one to morbidity, and a very short ring finger to showy fame.

meaning: The shape of the fingertip (pointed, broad, round, square) shows mental style.
inference: Tradition reads pointed tips as honest and brave, broad as planners, round as truth lovers, square as fixed in opinion, and a broad little finger as a quick-witted preacher.

meaning: A crooked finger gives up its own strength and takes on the nature of the finger it leans toward.
inference: Tradition gives pairings such as Jupiter leaning to Saturn spoiling Jupiter, Saturn leaning to Jupiter giving a renunciate, and Sun leaning to Mercury giving a trader.
variants: Saturn leaning toward Sun: mood swings
Mercury leaning toward Sun: prefers manual craft

meaning: Mouth shape and lip thickness are used for character reading.
inference: Tradition says an open wide mouth is brave, a small cunning mouth is cowardly, and thick lips show lust.

meaning: Eyebrow distance from the eyes and their curve are read for heart quality.
inference: Tradition says close arched brows mean kindness, while far straight brows show a hard heart of Saturn-Ketu type.

meaning: Eye size, depth, colour and defects are read as signs of nature.
inference: Tradition calls large bulging light eyes good and spiritual, small deep round eyes selfish, and squint or cat eyes deceitful or evil.

meaning: Walking style is used to read memory, thought and temperament.
inference: Tradition says slow gait means weak memory, quick short steps high thought, fast walking jealousy, and limping a revengeful nature.

meaning: The type of voice is linked to a character type, using sounds of animals and instruments.
inference: Tradition says loud heavy voice is brave, thunder-like is a good ruler, drum-like a music lover, and crow or vulture-like ruthless.

meaning: Gaps between joined fingers show when money is short, and also trouble at different life stages.
inference: Tradition says gaps mean money is unavailable when needed, no gaps mean ready money, with little-ring gap for childhood trouble, ring-middle for youth, middle-index for old age.

meaning: The head line (Mercury) and heart line (Moon) are treated as enemies, so their closeness matters.
inference: Tradition says the closer they are the narrower the heart and the more curt and biased the conduct, while a wide gap under the Sun mount means indifference to honour.

meaning: A narrow gap between head and heart lines under the Sun mount is the specific palm sign here.
inference: Tradition says narrow-heartedness, harsh dealing, bigotry and dislike of brothers and relatives, because Mercury is an enemy of Mars and Jupiter.

meaning: A heart line curving up toward Jupiter at its end, or lines from the index root to Jupiter, is a specific palm marking.
inference: Tradition says the person stays detached from worldly matters.

meaning: Straight branches reaching the Jupiter area between Saturn and Jupiter are read as a mild, firm love nature.
inference: Tradition says such a person is moderate in love, inwardly firm, and a friend whose friendship benefits many, with love turning divine.

meaning: Several lines on or toward the Moon mount are read: fakir line, Moon-to-Sun line, head line to Moon, life line ending on Moon, and marks of drowning.
inference: Tradition links these to modesty and saintliness, a bad life, imaginary worries, a father line, and drowning by day or night with stars or Saturn marks.
variants: Venus-mount star or dot: drowning by day
Saturn mark on Moon mount: drowning at night

meaning: A short line under the head line near Saturn is a specific palm marking tied to Jupiter and Mercury values.
inference: Tradition says the person changes opinions quickly like a spinning top.

meaning: A fish line with the health or progress line falling into its mouth is a specific palm combination.
inference: Tradition claims adultery or same-sex leaning, but a long-lived father, with only Moon-Mercury enmity harming the mother.

meaning: The 4th house, its lord and the Moon are all afflicted by Saturn, Rahu and Sun, while the 2nd and 12th are also damaged.
inference: Tradition says the native turns toward renunciation as a sanyasi, softened by a yellow sapphire in a gold ring.
variants: only 4th house and lord afflicted: weaker renunciation

meaning: Mars is tied to the lagna, the 4th house, their lords and the Moon at once.
inference: Tradition says the mind turns violent and hostile; Mars appeasement and Hanuman stotra are the stated remedy.

meaning: The lagna lord aspects the 10th lord and the 4th lord aspects the 7th lord, in a male chart where the 4th lord is a female planet.
inference: Tradition says this combination leads to adultery, with Jupiter strengthening as the remedy.

meaning: The Saturn dasha under the Lal Kitab Nashtabali scheme is described as a hard period.
inference: Tradition says men face addictions, opposition from sons and friends, and a sudden near-fatal crisis.

meaning: Saturn placed in the 1st house together with excessive body hair is the combination.
inference: Tradition reads this as a sign of poverty.

meaning: Saturn placed in the 5th house together with excess body hair is the combination.
inference: Tradition says the person may be a thief or deceiver, unlucky and troubled by litigation.

meaning: Saturn becomes malefic when the native indulges in liquor, gambling, lying, cheating or adultery.
inference: Tradition says Saturn then gives bad results even if it is exalted.

meaning: Rahu sits in the 4th house, or the 4th house falls in Aries, Cancer, Virgo or Gemini.
inference: Tradition says few words, discontent, cruelty, low company, one son, weak wife, trouble to mother and snake-bite danger.

meaning: Sun, Moon, Venus and Saturn are all together in the 1st house, with Aries rising as the book states.
inference: Tradition says a weak body, effeminate manner and timidity, yet a leader.
variants: same four planets in other lagna signs
